==Hero Usage==
* Heroes have a hard time using this skill.  They will almost always wait until they are nearly entirely drained of energy, sometimes ignoring it completely.

== Notes ==
* If used as soon and as efficiently (i.e., not going over maximum energy) as possible, this skill nets the equivalent of +2 [[pip]]s of energy regeneration at 11-12 Channeling Magic and 2.4 pips at 15 Channeling Magic.
* [[Spirit Siphon]] will usually be superior to Offering of Spirit when spirits are available. It is non-elite, only returns 2 less energy than Offering of Spirit at rank 12 or higher, but can be used potentially more often resulting in more energy overall.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
